correctness.rationale: PASS: On the ten antipodal regular-dodecahedron vertex lines, all pairwise off-diagonal dot products are ±1/3 or ±sqrt(5)/3; direct exact signed-Petersen identities D²=2I−D+J, U²=3I+W, UW=2U give the 1/5/4 even and 3/3/4 odd eigenspace multiplicities. The probability-sphere harmonic addition formula yields Gram G_l=(2l+1)P_l(x_i·x_j), with even normalized eigenvalues 1+3q+6p,1+q−2p,1−2q+p and odd 1+5q+2p,1−5q+2p,1−3p. Exact rational Legendre recurrences establish ranks (1,3,5,7,9,6,10,10,9,10,10,10,10,10,9) for l=0..14 and positivity for l=15..61. Bernstein Legendre inequality gives six |P_l(1/3)| plus three |P_l(sqrt5/3)| <1 from l=62 (explicit rational row-sum upper bound (1971/250)/sqrt(l+1/2)), hence positive definite by diagonal dominance for all larger degrees. Gram pseudoinverse proves feasibility/minimum-norm formula. Independently reconstructed exact rational recurrence and verified tail bounds; no finite extrapolation.
